scope: Deterministic model acquisition, explicit local context and import contracts. No browser or physical-device claim.
checks: N01 all four birds acquire concrete finite prey for four seeds at 60 Hz and 100 ms
N01 an explicit reached-site context starts a separate finite run after 240 or 1200 actual model seconds
N01 remote sites, missing sites and reused current run IDs cannot reset a context
N01 old provenance-free evidence and explicit new contexts roundtrip without losing notes or K3 validity
N01 K3 cannot cross a local context reset even when concrete individual IDs are identical
N01 contradictory own-run, site, backwards-time, missing-origin and cyclic imports are rejected
